execution_context.file_location: router firmware / web interface (HTTP request handler)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: os.system(request.GET['cmd'])  # or similar command injection via HTTP payload
malicious_snippets.code_language: python (or C, depending on router firmware)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code executes arbitrary system commands received via HTTP request parameters, allowing attackers to install malware such as Mirai on the device.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Accepting and executing user-supplied input as system commands is a classic command injection vulnerability, enabling remote code execution.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal router firmware should never execute arbitrary commands from unauthenticated HTTP requests.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate remote management interfaces may execute limited, authenticated commands, but never arbitrary unauthenticated input.
key_indicators: Direct use of user input in system command execution
Lack of authentication or input validation
Observed installation of Mirai variant after exploitation

attack_chain.action: Attacker sends specially crafted HTTP request exploiting CVE-2021-20090 to vulnerable router.
attack_chain.leads_to: Remote code execution on the device

attack_chain.action: Malicious payload (Mirai variant) is downloaded and executed on the compromised device.
attack_chain.leads_to: Device becomes part of Mirai botnet

behavioral_signatures: Execution of system commands based on HTTP request parameters
Unusual outbound connections from router to known Mirai C2 infrastructure
Unexpected process creation on embedded devices
file_indicators: Presence of Mirai-related binaries in router filesystem
Modification of startup scripts to persist malware
network_indicators: Outbound connections to Mirai C2 IPs (often in China, e.g., Wuhan)
Unusual HTTP requests with 'cmd' or similar parameters to router web interface
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor router and IoT device logs for command injection attempts via HTTP requests, look for new or unexpected binaries/processes, and alert on outbound connections to known Mirai C2 infrastructure. Use IPS/IDS signatures for CVE-2021-20090 and related command injection patterns.
